reasoning_content: I see! The server has `/world` static mounted but the route for `/world-assets/` and `/world/` might not include the client config. Let me add those missing routes and ensure they work. But first, let me also check what files exist in world directory:

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko

client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check what files exist in game-data/world
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/game-data/world/ 2>/dev/null || ls -la /opt/areloria/world/ | head -10")
print("World dir:", stdout.read().decode()[:500])

# Create client config if missing
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls /opt/areloria/game-data/world/are-performance-policy.json 2>/dev/null || echo 'NOT FOUND'")
print("Config:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
